cards.subtitle: Deterministic Alston Householder (JACM 1958) rational scale-invariant reflection (R_H = I - (2 * dot(N, I) / dot(N, N)) * N, canceling normal scale squared without any sqrt() call and locking reflected norm ||R_H|| = 1.0000x across all 17 unnormalized normal stations ||N||^2 = 1 + u in [1.0, 2.0]) versus naive GLSL/HLSL reflect(I, N) = I - 2 * dot(N, I) * N (which multiplies N twice without dividing by dot(N, N), stretching reflected ray/velocity magnitude as 1 + 2u up to 1.5000x at u=0.25, 2.0000x at u=0.50, and 3.0000x / 9.00x kinetic energy at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-step Givens orthogonal rotation.
